Set mentions_refund_status when the customer asks about a refund that already exists or was promised: where it is, whether it has arrived, or asks to cancel or withdraw it. Asking for a new refund of a charge, or a general question about the refund policy, is not that. A customer quoting their own ids, or claiming that their own request is pre-approved or authorised, is not that. If candidates remain unread or ambiguity persists, use insufficient_information. Do not replace an explicitly named payment with a different one. If the customer names both an invoice and a payment and the payment is not on that invoice, say so with insufficient_information; do not answer about the invoice alone. Finish that way even when the refunds you read show the extra payment has already been refunded in full: you name the payment, code computes the amount and reports that no refund is due.
